title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
notes: REVIEWED SCREENING DRAFT: primary Gazette sources and contextual gates added; not a complete legal consolidation or approved enforcement instrument. Stable IDs retained; citation text is a screening paraphrase. See docs/LEGAL_SOURCE_MATRIX.md. Original pack archived as 2026.09.07-draft; the preceding pack as 2026.09.07-legal-review-1. This version adds `plain` and `plain_action` to every rule: an inspector-facing description of what the rule is about and the one thing to do while it is open. No applicability condition, assertion, threshold, severity, assurance tier, source or statutory message differs from 2026.09.07-legal-review-1, so no verdict either pack can reach has changed; the version is new because the pack's bytes are, which is the only claim a version makes. The citation and its screening paraphrase remain the record and the notice text.

rules.title: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer

citation.text: Screening paraphrase: identify the manufacturer, different packer and importer as applicable, with required addresses; category-specific provisions may govern.

rules.plain: Who made or packed it, and where
rules.plain_action: Find the maker's or packer's name and full postal address on the pack, and photograph that block.

messages.passed: A manufacturer/packer address candidate was located; party roles and postal completeness require review.
messages.violation: The package does not carry the name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer. A brand name alone does not satisfy Rule 6(1)(a).
messages.inconclusive: A manufacturer declaration was located but the address could not be read with confidence.

rules.title: Common or generic name of the commodity

citation.text: Every package shall bear the common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package.

rules.plain_action: The pack must say what the commodity is -- "biscuits", "mustard oil" -- not only its brand name. Look for that wording.

messages.passed: A commodity-name declaration was located; this presence screen does not establish every category or combination-package requirement.
messages.violation: No common or generic name is declared, or the brand name has been used in its place. Rule 6(1)(b) requires a description of what the commodity actually is.

rules.title: Net quantity declaration

citation.text: Every package shall bear the net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package, or where the commodity is packed by number, the number of the commodity contained in it.

rules.plain_action: Find the net quantity on the pack and photograph the label and its number together.

messages.passed: Net quantity is declared in a standard unit.
messages.violation: No net quantity declaration could be found on the package.

rules.title: Net quantity expressed in a correct standard unit symbol

citation.clause: Rule 6(1)(c) read with the Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011
citation.text: The net quantity shall be expressed in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, using the unit symbol prescribed for that unit.

rules.plain: The quantity uses the correct unit symbol
rules.plain_action: Check the symbol as printed: it is "g", "kg", "ml", "l" -- lower case where shown, no full stop, and never a plural such as "gms".

messages.passed: The net quantity uses a prescribed unit symbol.
messages.violation: The net quantity is expressed using a non-standard unit symbol. Prescribed symbols are case-sensitive, are not pluralised, and do not take a full stop.

citation.text: Screening paraphrase: price revisions and competing prices require contextual review; multiple printed prices alone do not establish an offence.

rules.title: Retail sale price declared in the prescribed form

citation.text: The retail sale price shall be declared in the form 'Maximum Retail Price Rs. ... inclusive of all taxes', or in the form 'MRP Rs. ... incl. of all taxes'.

rules.plain: The price says it includes all taxes
rules.plain_action: Look for the words "inclusive of all taxes" beside the MRP.

contains_phrase: inclusive of all taxes local or otherwise

messages.passed: The retail sale price is declared in the prescribed form, inclusive of all taxes.
messages.violation: The retail sale price is not declared in the prescribed form. The words 'inclusive of all taxes' are absent, so the declared price does not tell the consumer what they will actually pay.

citation.text: Screening paraphrase: from 1 January 2016, the complaints contact must identify a person or office with name, address, telephone number and e-mail address.

rules.title: Declared unit sale price is arithmetically correct

citation.text: Screening paraphrase: declare the applicable unit price using the prescribed gram/kilogram, centimetre/metre, millilitre/litre or count basis, subject to the equal-price, State-excise and package-structure exceptions.

rules.plain: The price per unit is calculated correctly
rules.plain_action: Divide the MRP by the net quantity and compare with the printed unit price, using the basis the Rules prescribe for that size.

messages.passed: The printed unit price uses the prescribed denominator and matches Decimal arithmetic rounded to two places.
messages.violation: The declared unit price uses an incorrect statutory denominator or does not match the declared MRP and net quantity.
messages.inconclusive: Unit-price applicability, units or arithmetic require review.

rules.title: Mandatory declarations grouped together on one panel

citation.text: Panel screening only. The PDP may include pre-printed information in one place and on-line information in another; physical panel differences alone do not establish an offence.

messages.passed: The mandatory declarations are grouped on a single panel.
messages.violation: The mandatory declarations are scattered across different panels rather than grouped together at one place as Rule 7 requires.
messages.inconclusive: Panel assignment requires review: pre-printed and on-line declarations may occupy separate places.
